FIELDS.NAME: ParcelPro Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At ParcelPro Services, we specialize in providing comprehensive mail and packaging solutions, including domestic and international shipping, packaging, and logistics management. Our operations focus on delivering reliable and efficient services to both retail and business clients. We utilize reputable shipping carriers to ensure timely and secure delivery of parcels. Our facility is equipped with modern shipping technology and follows all local, state, and federal regulations to uphold the highest standards of compliance and data protection. We also maintain robust security measures to protect our inventory and customer information. Additionally, we offer limited ancillary services, such as basic printing and notary services, which complement our core operations. Our trained staff is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service and ensuring that all shipping procedures are consistently applied.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – ParcelPro Services carries Workers' Compensation insurance to protect our employees and comply with legal requirements. This policy is active and up to date, ensuring coverage for any work-related injuries.

FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – ParcelPro Services does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Our current policy is sufficient for our operational needs.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – ParcelPro Services is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our focus is solely on providing mail and packaging solutions.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – ParcelPro Services does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations focus solely on providing mail and packaging solutions without engaging in equipment rental activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – ParcelPro Services has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial position and complies with relevant regulations.
